misprints.note: No circumflex printed on the final syllable, although the διαδοχῆς just before has one.
The n is printed as a turned letter (u).
The opening quotation mark before taga is missing in the print.
Printed as shown, with the circumflex on the iota.

uncertain.note: The mark on the final ύ could be an acute or a breathing. I read it as an acute.
The vowel looks like υ (τύ), probably a broken ο. I kept τό.
The mark on the second ι looks like a smooth breathing or an acute (possibly ἰτεΐνη). I kept ἰτείνη.
The point after ἐπαλλάξ is raised to mid-height (·), possibly a full stop knocked out of place. I kept '.'.
The ν of ἐν is damaged and looks like ύ. I read it as ἐν.
